# Project Summary

## Overview
Modern portfolio website for Fahad Khalid showcasing Computer Science expertise, projects, and achievements.

## Key Metrics
- **Total Lines**: ~4,100
- **Components**: 19
- **Data Modules**: 6
- **Build Time**: < 5s
- **Bundle Size**: Optimized with Vite

## Technology Stack
- React 18 + TypeScript
- Tailwind CSS + Framer Motion
- Vite (Build Tool)

## Design Philosophy
Minimalistic, futuristic, and professional with:
- Deep navy background (#0A192F)
- Cyan-purple gradients
- Glassmorphism effects
- Smooth animations

## Deployment Ready
✅ Production build optimized
✅ Responsive design
✅ SEO friendly
✅ Fast loading
✅ Type safe

## Quick Commands
```bash
npm install    # Install dependencies
npm run dev    # Start dev server
npm run build  # Production build
npm run preview # Preview build
```
